0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (0-1, 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West) make their third game of the season a road trip to the Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West). Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique, strain) are out for Phoenix, and Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery) are out for Oklahoma City. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Suns lost 2-3 to the Thunder in 2025-26 and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, most recently a 131-122 loss in Phoenix on April 27, 2026.
